messages:
Hannah Lee: Heads-up: planning a small "launch lab" next week — quick blog post + targeted in-product banner -> two cohort arms for credit incentives. want to validate which credit size and placement best drives 5-request activation.
Diego Alvarez: love the lab framing. what are the arms?
Hannah Lee: arm 1 = 100-token claim on post -> installs prompt templates immediately. arm 2 = no upfront credit, but 150-token offer post-webinar to attendees. control = post + banner, no credit.
Priya Shah: routing: where do signups go? growth inbox for all, but enterprise domains -> create SF lead and tag "lab-credits-2026".
Jenny Ortiz: creative ask: one hero image, two banner widths, and three social cards. also need 2 short walkthrough GIFs (install + run). can design deliver by Tue noon?
Hannah Lee: Tue noon works. timeline: draft post Mon AM, design Tue, soft-launch Wed 9am PT to seeded 8k users, run 9 days.
Diego Alvarez: tracking events (Mixpanel):

```
lab_post_click
credit_claimed_lab
prompt_templates_installed
first_5_requests
webinar_rsvp
```

Add campaign property: "launchlab-2026-q2" for all events.
Priya Shah: analytics nuance: need to dedupe users who claim credit after RSVP vs before. also capture "credit_offer_source" = post|banner|email.
Hannah Lee: good call. we'll add that property.
Jenny Ortiz: subject line tests: "Ship an LLM feature in 5 requests (free credits)" vs "Join our mini-demo + get credits" — which for cold vs warm?
Priya Shah: cold -> first, warm -> second. split by cohort source.
Diego Alvarez: we should A/B credit size too: 50 vs 100 tokens for arm 1 (randomize within). metric: % reaching first_5 within 48h and cost per converted user.
Hannah Lee: ops question: can eng enable a temporary fast-path model for this cohort to reduce latency during demo? want to avoid friction.
launch-bot: note: feature flag "launchlab_fastpath" created, default off.
Priya Shah: routing rules draft: enterprise domain -> SF lead + tag `lab-enterprise`; others -> growth inbox. if redeemed_tokens >= 150 -> escalate to sales SDR. post webhook to #growth-notify with payload (email_domain, campaign, redeemed_tokens).
Diego Alvarez: reporting: post-launch benchmark doc should include: hypothesis, channel mix, cohort size, lift on first_5, token economics (tokens redeemed * token_cost + infra uplift), surprises, recommended next step.
Hannah Lee: yes. Product wants latency & cost per request in the benchmark so they can judge model selection tradeoffs.
Jenny Ortiz: creative calendar: deliverables Tue noon, final QA Tue 5pm, assets posted Wed 7am to #marketing-prod.
Priya Shah: I'll build dashboard: funnel from post_click -> claim -> first_5 and include per-arm cost. ETA Fri.
Hannah Lee: final: run control/both arms to 8k, collect 10 days, postmortem 1 week after end. tagging follow-ups: @Jenny (creative), @Diego (tracking), @Priya (dashboard). thanks team! :sparkles:
